name: com.liminallabs.atlas
description: Knowing where things are: compass bearing and on-screen indicators from one registration, over a registry that already models map spaces. M0 - the registry, the marker vocabulary, the space identity, two projections and two presenters. Namespace LiminalLabs.Atlas.

samples.description: Three markers registered three different ways, on a compass bar and as screen indicators, from one registry. Import this sample first - the scene builder lives in Samples~, so its menu item does not exist until you do. Then: Window > Liminal Labs > Atlas > Build M0 Sample Scene.
